alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

root_cause.hypothesis: checkout tasks crash-looping on OOM: each new task allocates a 900MiB in-process cache shortly after start, memory pressure warning fires, then MemoryError kills the process; ECS keeps replacing the dead task (7 restarts in ~4min) so desired=2 never stabilizes and one task stays pending. Task memory limit appears too small for the 900MiB cache alloc. Deploy revision 42 (python:3.12-alpine → python:3.12.7-alpine) is a patch-only bump, timestamp precedes crash loop by ~30min, so likely coincidental/not causal — unless 3.12.7 alpine build shifted baseline interpreter memory footprint enough to tip it over the limit.
evidence: Every restarted task logs identical sequence: started → WARN memory pressure rising → allocating 900MiB cache
7 task restarts within ~4 minutes (16:59:05 to 17:02:36 UTC), classic crash-loop pattern
Final task f3dca68f produces explicit Python Traceback: MemoryError right after the 900MiB alloc
tasks_pending=1 with deployments_in_flight=2 and tasks_running still at desired(2) indicates rollout stuck replacing crashing tasks
cpu_utilization_pct ~0.005% (near-idle) rules out CPU-bound cause, isolates issue to memory
deploy record shows only patch version change (3.12 → 3.12.7 alpine), same major/minor, at 22:28:18 IST (16:58:18 UTC) — ~47s before first crash log, so timing does loosely align with deploy
ruled_out: Deployment config/task-definition registration failure — revision registered cleanly (registered_at present, deployments_failed=0.0)
Networking/health-check failure — no such errors in logs, failure is explicit MemoryError

proposal.reasoning: Crash loop root cause: app allocates 900MiB in-process cache on every task start, exceeds task memory limit, MemoryError kills proc, ECS respawns forever (7 restarts/~4min, one task stuck pending). Not a transient blip fixable by restart/scale — task hard-crashes deterministically right after start every time. Revert to python:3.12-alpine unlikely to help per hypothesis (patch bump timing precedes crash window ~30min, probably coincidental) — rollback risks no fix + wasted deploy cycle. Real fix needs task definition memory limit raised or app cache size reduced/config change — code/infra change outside allowed automated actions.
proposal.expected_effect: No automated fix applied. Human engineer reviews task def memory limit vs 900MiB cache need, bumps memory limit or fixes cache alloc, redeploys. Prevents blind restart/rollback loop that won't resolve underlying OOM.

reasons: Action is inert or advisory; no approval required.
